snippet.title: Dream Life (2005) Plug n' Play - Nostalgic Gameplay & Music (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
2005 DREAM LIFE Plug and Play by Hasbro. Plug & Play consoles were a popular thing in the early 2000s, usually featuring a plug-in game that could be played immediately from the comfort of your home on your TV.

If you're like me, you were totally obsessed with this game as a kid and have not been able to find a video featuring the music and gameplay. Sooo, here it is! :) I think I managed to get the full loop for each song in the game, but if I missed one let me know. I think there are about 4 total music loops you can find, with various ambient sound elsewhere. Also, my map is in the "snowy" state because the seasons change as you progress which is a cute detail!

Side note: If you want to play this game and you don't have the console, you can emulate it using MAME. Make sure to version match your MAME emulator with the ROM for DreamLife, because MAME has likely updated since this ROM came out. I used this tutorial https://www.tiktok.com/@jaeserys/video/6932232412726447365 and simply downloaded an older version of MAME (at the time of writing, this is ver .228) to get the DL ROM working. 
(Disclaimer: I am not advocating for or against emulators, but I think preserving old media is important and this is one accessible way to do it)
